why: Fast changes in G with one barre chord dropped in: the **A-shape minor barre** (Bm) at tempo.
hard_change: **Em → Bm barre in one beat** (chorus bars 3–4). Place the index barre first, then the other three fingers together.
theory: Chorus I–V–vi–iii–V–I. The iii (Bm) is the “minor barre on the A string” lesson.
steps: Changes alone, slowly: Em → Bm → D, one strum each.
With the rhythm at 70% (about 84 bpm), driving eighths.
With the record (Kinks in G; check the Fall cover against your mix copy).
caveat: Chords are the Kinks original in G; the Fall cover's key is unverified — if it doesn't match your mix, move the shapes.
